variants.name: 스타 골드
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE standalone golden-drink can design preview for a vending-machine game.
Input image 1 is a STYLE reference only: match the drinks' clean dark outlines, moderately realistic container proportions, restrained illustrated highlights and game-item readability. Do NOT reproduce the contact sheet, other drinks or a game screen.
Create exactly ONE upright aluminum beverage CAN, head-on with a small visible top ellipse, crimped rim, top lid and pull tab. Standard drink-can proportions, no bottle neck or glass. Complete can visible, centered at consistent scale on a plain warm off-white square canvas with generous blank margins. Small soft contact shadow. Simple enough to work at inventory-slot scale; crisp edges, controlled detail, no photoreal studio advertising set.
This is a special golden drink. Use convincing gold metal reflections and a few tiny close sparkle accents to convey rarity. No large halo or explosions. Original generic packaging, only the plain word GOLD on the can, no real brands, recognizable copied logos, product claims or gameplay stats. Do not add labels outside the can, headings, mockup annotations, accessories, coins or any other objects.
Keep the same illustration style, can dimensions, view, canvas and item scale across variants. One distinct design only.
Specific design direction for variant 01: Refine the current reference golden can: polished amber-gold body, a small matte black rectangular front panel with a fine double gold border, original eight-point star above small upright serif GOLD. Restrained engraved corner details. Gold lid and subtle light metal ridges. A luminous gold vertical reflection, two tiny white-gold glints. Special and rich but not overly ornate.
